# Forgot password
{: .no_toc }

Request a password-reset email.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `AUTH-05` |
| **Route** | `/forgot-password` · deep link `substratal://forgot-password` |
| **Who can use it** | Unauthenticated |
| **Kind** | auth |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Separate `AdwWindow` with `AdwClamp` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Email | email-field | body.email | prefilled from AUTH-01 | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=email |
| Send reset link | primary-button | POST /auth/password/forgot |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Send reset link | `POST /auth/password/forgot` | Always 202 → confirmation "If an account exists for {email}, we sent a reset link." 429 → countdown. |
